item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i bla 'gug tshe yi dmu thag srog gi chad mthud dwangs ma bcud 'gug
item.coloph: ces rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung mthu chen gyi tshe sgrub g.yung drung gur khang gi cha lag bla 'gug srog gi dmu thag chad 'thud dwangs ma bcud 'gug zhes bya ba 'di yang / snying grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i nor la dbang ba'i dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs nas snga nas bskul ba dang / rang slob g.yung drung phun tshogs nas tshe gos dkar mo dri med yug ring gis brda mtshon nas nan tan gyis bskul bas/ rang yang bag chags kyi snang ba rab rib tsam 'dug kyang btang snyoms su song bas/ phyis su shar grol smin gling du nyin gyi bya ba la yengs zhing / mtshan gyi gti mug ye shes kyi grogs su skyong ba'i nub mor tho rings (rangs) la dam can pho nya sde bzhi dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas nas/ khyed kyis bstan 'gror phan yod pa'i bon sbyin zer ba dang/ phyir nyin bla chung bstan dbang gis tshe yi zhal bu mngar gsum gyis bkang ba snang ba'i grogs su spro ba dang / g.yung drung phun tshogs kyis tshe yi shel sgong dri med sogs rten 'brel shin tu legs pa'i brda rtags shar nas da skabs/ gzugs med pa'i sgra la/ le lo 'du byed g.yeng ba'i blo dor la/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nub med yongs la phyor zhes thos pas/ snang ba'i grogs dang bcas nas tshe dbang rol gar tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i mtshan ni g.yung drung thog med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis shar grol smin gling du rig 'dzin chen po'i zhal lung bzhin dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o/ dge des nyu le tshe yi bar chad zhi nas 'chi med tshe dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
